recommendedSlice.name: Active-ride camera composition (phase-aware, tick-stable)
whySmallestSafestUseful: Closes the largest remaining functional UX gap observed in MAP-2A physical proof (poor framing / single-pin composition) without inventing motion, routes, or ETA.
Pure Flutter presentation: ActiveRideMapCameraPolicy + ActiveRideMap only.
No backend authority change, no RTDB schema/rules, no driver publisher, no MAP-1, no new Firebase listeners, no new Google Maps APIs.
Corrects an internal inconsistency: fitIdentity currently includes 4-decimal driver coords, fighting the stated no-refit-every-tick doctrine.
Leaves visual design (theme, 3D, custom markers, cinematic motion) fully deferred while keeping policy pure/testable for that future phase.
exactInScope: Rework ActiveRideMapCameraPolicy.fitIdentity so driver presence/phase/anchors drive refit — NOT fine-grained driver lat/lng every ~11m

Phase-aware composition: no-driver → fit pickup+destination; to_pickup → prefer bounds covering driver+pickup (optionally include destination when span remains readable); to_dest → driver+destination (optionally keep pickup if span ok)
Refit triggers only: first driver fix appears/disappears, HTTP ride state phase change (to_pickup↔to_dest), pickup/dest identity change, optional explicit passenger 'Recenter' control
Modest padding/height tuning for readable composition on SM-A325F (functional, not visual branding)
Unit tests for policy identities + phase fits; widget test that rapid seq updates do not spam animateCamera
Physical proof on SM-A325F that phase transitions reframe correctly and mid-publish ticks do not thrash camera
exactOutOfScope: MAP-1 RideMapPreview / pricing polyline / ride request flow
MAP-2A RTDB listener architecture / TripLocationSession contracts
Route polylines (road or straight) — Candidate C later
Marker interpolation / cinematic motion language — Candidate B / visual phase
Custom Ora markers, dark map theme, 3D buildings, Mapbox, glow, shadows

stateLifecycleBehavior.RIDE_STARTED: Phase flip to_dest → one intentional refit to driver+destination

stateLifecycleBehavior.staleLocation: Freshness alpha/hide unchanged; camera must not chase expired phantom — treat missing driver as anchors-only identity
